source: These numbers can disagree without contradiction. A kernel might have 100% NVML utilization because it runs continuously, 50% occupancy because register use limits residency, high memory throughput because ZXNAME0000XZ is near its ceiling, and modest arithmetic throughput because the kernel is bandwidth-bound.
zh: 这些数字可以不一致，但并不矛盾。内核可能具有 100% NVML 利用率（因为它连续运行）、50% 占用率（因为寄存器使用限制驻留时间）、高内存吞吐量（因为 ZXNAME0000XZ 接近其上限）以及适度的算术吞吐量（因为内核受带宽限制）。
